summary: Liberty County entry GA211 on a compiled Georgia tower list: coordinates, elevation and two codes only. No build, staffing or fate source found; not on the NHLR list.

evidence.supports: Name, coordinates, county, elevation and two codes of the Peacock Creek row (GA211)
The NHLR Georgia list has 29 towers, and the Peacock Creek tower is not among them
evidence.quote: There are 29 lookouts registered in Georgia.

notes_for_editor: Only one source places this tower: the tnlandforms.us compiled list, row GA211, which gives the codes BLL-64698 and gfc-127 without explaining them (the record carries them as BLL US 64698 and GFC US 127). Not on the NHLR Georgia list (29 entries, read in full) or the Former Fire Lookout Sites Georgia list (2 sites, Lafayette and Yonah Mountain). Not on the Eastern US Lookouts Georgia list either, which is undated. Two web searches (general Peacock Creek fire tower, and one adding Fort Stewart) found no tower record; the hits were USGS stream gauges named Peacock Creek near Midway and McIntosh, which are streams, not towers, and nothing ties this entry to Fort Stewart. The list gives elevation 17 with no unit; the record's 5.2 m assumes feet, which fits the rest of the list (Brasstown at 4735 is only plausible in feet). The story is about 90 words, below the 120-word floor, because nothing else describes the tower; suggest holding it as a stub. No photos. Next checks if time allows: Georgia Forestry Commission tower records, Liberty County or Midway newspapers, Fort Stewart public affairs.
